metadata.description: Commercial real estate tools — lease abstraction, MLS data extraction, MCDA sales comparison valuation, relative valuation competitive positioning, and tenant credit analysis

plugins.name: cre-lease-abstraction
plugins.description: Commercial real estate lease abstraction using REIXS-LA-NA-001 methodology and 258-field Domain Data Dictionary

plugins.name: mls-extractor
plugins.description: Extract MLS property listings from PDF reports into professionally formatted Excel spreadsheets with subject property highlighting

plugins.name: mcda-sales-comparison
plugins.description: MCDA ordinal ranking for fee simple valuation — ranks subject and comparables on weighted characteristics, maps composite scores to value via interpolation and regression

plugins.name: mcda-lease-comparison
plugins.description: MCDA competitive positioning analysis — ranks subject property against comparables on up to 25 weighted variables, calculates sensitivity analysis to achieve Top 3 positioning, and generates a strategic pricing report with landscape PDF output

plugins.name: tenant-credit
plugins.description: Tenant credit analysis — extracts financial data from PDF statements, runs 15+ ratio analysis and 100-point weighted credit scoring (A–F rating), calculates default probability and expected loss, and generates a credit report with security deposit recommendations

plugins.name: cam-reconciliation-cre
plugins.description: CRE-native CAM reconciliation engine — lease-aware recoverability, deterministic allocation math, tenant statements, and comparison vs generic finance workflows
